integrity: No external paper or unverified program results are reproduced as independent certification; executable finite checks accompany the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for simple cycles and the specified two-time-level linear update over finite fields. The finite checkers corroborate but do not prove the universal result. Macfarlane (2004) has been compared through its abstract only; potential hidden finite-ring equivalents remain an originality risk. No independent audit has taken place.
title: An exact periodic-orbit census for reversible finite-field waves on cycles
